current_role: Not used: fuses were dropped from the whole robot and the tether (owner decision 2026-10-11/12; the live guide marks them not used). Received in DigiKey order 101587695 and kept as owned stock.

model: DFRobot FIT0586 XT30 male+female pair / DigiKey 1738-1436-ND
role_zh: Polarized detachable interface between the 12 V tether and the onboard regulator.
notes_zh: Received in DigiKey order 101587695. One package contains one mating pair. The tether side uses the recessed female contacts; the robot side uses the male contacts. Four solder cups need 18 AWG wires and heat shrink. Mark 12V INPUT; never mate to a 5 V load. Read 11.5-12.5 V at the female before it meets the robot.

model: 18AWG flexible stranded copper, red+black, 2m operating run
role_zh: Carries 12 V (about 1.1 A walking, about 2.7 A in 20 ms peaks) from the SMPS2DXL cable splices to the robot XT30, so the long wire never carries 5 V motor current.
notes_zh: Obtain 2.2 m each of red and black 18 AWG copper including termination allowance; use a 2 m operating tether. Splice the ROBOTIS cable's middle wire (+12 V) to red and its outer GND wire to black, cover both splices with heat shrink and tie the cable to the tether before and after them. Expected drop about 0.2 V at 2.7 A. Exact club stock remains unverified.

model: Four precrimped female 2.54mm leads, 22AWG, 250mm, fixed insulated housing
role_zh: Two parallel positive leads to physical pins 2/4 and two returns to physical 6/14.
notes_zh: Two red and two black 250mm 22AWG leads; terminals must explicitly accept 22AWG. each contact rating >=1.5A. Pi needs a pre-soldered male 40-pin header. Pin 9 remains IMU ground, pin 20 audio signal ground. Keep PWR IN empty and covered; strain-relieve the fixed housing. Do not substitute unrated loose jumpers. Populate the dedicated unified 2x20 housing item; do not stack four individual socket housings under a second full-width housing.

role_zh: Owned. No robot role since 2026-10-13; optional day-1 bench source for the Adafruit 5991.
notes_zh: User supplied the exact charger label. No charger purchase. Its fixed 20V/3.25A PD mode was the r3 robot source until 2026-10-13.
scope_note: No robot role since 2026-10-13: the ROBOTIS SMPS 12V 5A + SMPS2DXL wall end replaced the MDY-14-ED 20 V PD chain. Owned; it may feed the Adafruit 5991 in the optional day-1 5 V bench step.

model: Xiaomi original modified USB-A male to USB-C male charger cable
role_zh: No robot role since 2026-10-13. It connected the MDY-14-ED to the Adafruit 5991 in the r3 chain.
notes_zh: No purchase released. The 12 V wall end does not use it; the robot needs no availability check for it.
scope_note: No robot role since 2026-10-13 (12 V ROBOTIS wall end). Owned; not needed for the robot.

name_zh: Tether splice insulation and strain relief
model: Heat shrink for the two splices and the DATA wire end, three small cable ties, 12V polarity label
role_zh: Insulates the SMPS2DXL cable splices and keeps tether pull off the solder joints and the SMPS2DXL plug.
notes_zh: Club material. No enclosure: the SMPS2DXL board and the supply stay outside the robot, and nothing is soldered onto the board. Ties go before and after the splices and next to the SMPS2DXL plug (guide step pd-tether).
current_role: Splice insulation and tie strain relief for the 12 V wall end (2026-10-13); no receiver or fuse enclosure.

model: Multimeter, electronic load >=60W, oscilloscope and temperature probe
role_zh: Verify 11.5-12.5 V at the XT30, voltage drop under load, thermal load and startup/stop transients.
notes_zh: Borrow instruments before powered assembly acceptance; current-limited bench supply and a multimeter alone do not measure the required transient waveform. No tool purchase is released.
current_role: Borrow first; the 12 V wall end needs no USB PD readout.

model: ROBOTIS SMPS 12V 5A (PS-10) with AC cord, OMX-AI kit accessory
role_zh: The one wall source for the robot since 2026-10-13: 12 V into the SMPS2DXL power jack.
notes_zh: One set from an OMX-AI kit allocated to the duck (order 2034348); not the arm's set and not the reserved third kit. Stays outside the robot. No purchase. Its 5 A covers the walking peaks of about 2.7 A at 12 V.
current_role: Owned kit accessory; robot wall supply since 2026-10-13.

model: ROBOTIS SMPS2Dynamixel (SMPS2DXL), SKU 902-0034-000, OMX-AI kit accessory
role_zh: Puts the supply's 12 V on pin 2 (VDD) of every socket; the cut 3-wire cable carries it to the tether.
notes_zh: One set from an OMX-AI kit allocated to the duck (order 2034348); not the arm's set and not the reserved third kit. Stays outside the robot. No purchase. Every socket is live at 12 V when the supply is plugged in. Nothing is soldered onto the board; the cable stays plugged in and is tied to the board next to its plug. Reference: robotis.us/smps2dynamixel, cited in guide/content/wiring/smps2dxl.py.
current_role: Owned kit accessory; 12 V wall end since 2026-10-13.

name_zh: SMPS2DXL 3-wire cable, far plug cut off
model: ROBOTIS 3-wire cable plugged into the SMPS2DXL, OMX-AI kit accessory
role_zh: Carries +12 V (middle wire, ROBOTIS pin 2 VDD) and GND (outer wire, pin 1) to the tether splices; the DATA wire (pin 3) is cut short and insulated.
notes_zh: One set from an OMX-AI kit allocated to the duck (order 2034348); not the arm's set and not the reserved third kit. Stays outside the robot. No purchase. Find GND with a meter: red probe on the middle wire; the outer wire that reads 11.5-12.5 V is GND. Wire-to-wire solder splices only; the cable keeps its full length and only the far plug is cut.
current_role: Owned kit accessory, cut and spliced to the tether (guide step pd-tether).
